info.description: Transactional email API for the Vibast notifications service. All routes require a bearer API key.
info.title: Vibast Notifications API

get.description: Lists every API key with its scopes, domains and status. The secret is never returned.

post.description: Creates an API key. domains are required (≥1) when scopes include "send" and must each be in ALLOWED_DOMAINS. The plaintext key is returned exactly once.

delete.description: Revokes a key. A key cannot revoke itself (400 invalid_request).

put.description: Replaces the sender domain list of a key (≥1, each in ALLOWED_DOMAINS for a send key).

get.description: Paginated message history with filters. Cursor pagination on (createdAt, id) descending; pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Filter by status (queued, sending, sent, failed, suppressed)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Filter by owning API key id
parameters.name: apiKeyId

parameters.description: Only messages created at or after this time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: createdFrom

parameters.description: Only messages created at or before this time (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: createdTo

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

get.description: Full message detail for debugging: the consumer view plus bodies, headers, attachment metadata, owning key, lock columns and full event payloads.
Streams the attachment content with its Content-Type and a Content-Disposition filename. Returns 410 gone once the content has been purged by retention.

post.description: Re-queues a message that is currently failed (status set to queued, re-dispatched). Returns 409 invalid_state when the message is in any other status.

get.description: Returns the reputation circuit-breaker state: whether sending is paused and, if so, the reason, since when, and who paused it.

post.description: Manually pauses sending. Queued and newly accepted messages accumulate until sending is resumed. An optional reason is recorded.
Manually resumes sending after an automatic or manual pause. The sweeper re-dispatches the queued backlog.

get.description: Per-bucket accepted/sent/failed/suppressed/delivered/bounced/complained counts over a UTC window, with totals, 24h rolling bounce/complaint rates, sending state and live backlog gauges.

parameters.description: Window start (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Default: 7 days ago
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Window end (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Default: now
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Bucket size: day or hour (default day)
parameters.name: granularity

get.description: Paginated suppression list. Cursor pagination on (createdAt, email) descending.

parameters.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Suppresses an address (reason "manual"). Returns 409 conflict when the address is already suppressed.

delete.description: Removes a suppression by email. Returns 404 when the address is not suppressed.

post.description: Validate a send request, store it queued (or suppressed if every recipient is suppressed), and hand it to the dispatcher. Returns 202 for a new message and 200 for an idempotent replay of the same idempotencyKey.

200.description: Idempotent replay of an existing message

get.description: Returns the message status, recipients and event timeline. Bodies and attachment contents are never returned. 404 when the id is unknown or owned by another API key.
get.summary: Get an email's status and timeline

post.description: Receives AWS SNS deliveries carrying SES events. The SNS signature is verified and the topic ARN checked against the allow-list; there is no bearer auth. SubscriptionConfirmation messages are auto-confirmed; Notification messages update message/recipient state. Returns 200 once a message is verified (even for an unknown message id), 403 on a bad signature or disallowed topic, and 400 on a malformed body.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer API key, e.g. "Authorization: Bearer ntf_xxxxxxxx_…".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
